rules: one series or episode production run uses one top-level job_id
repairs stay inside the same run and job_id
events are live telemetry; durable run state is the source of truth
a generator never certifies its own output
agent role and model selection are separate decisions
apply model-router before starting a new delegated model worker
core production ends at APPROVED; channel delivery runs as a separate adapter job and must not mutate the Drama production state machine

event_bus_ownership.rule: leaf specialists and the studio producer never block production by attempting Event Bus wait/history/progress/health; only the owning XChat orchestrator consumes the stream

execution_policy.rule: parallelize independent provider work only when files and continuity dependencies do not overlap; never run competing writers against the same durable episode assets

routing_policy.integration_review: strong model only when ambiguity or failed evidence justifies escalation
routing_policy.repair: reuse the same suitable profile/thread where possible; do not upgrade merely because a retry exists
routing_policy.context: give each specialist only the bounded source files and evidence needed for its stage

runtime_state.principle: state files record durable business truth; runs/<series-name>/<YYYY-MM-DD[-slug]>/generated/manifest.json remains artifact-stage provenance

success_evidence: episode script exists
shot intent exists
story beat and dialogue review completed
image artifact exists
sidecar records prompt and source inputs
canonical character and style constraints are reviewable
audio artifact is a valid WAV
spoken content matches the durable script
voice direction is acceptable for the scene
video artifact is decodable and has positive duration
sidecar records prompt, references, and hash
sampled evidence supports character and location continuity
previous-shot continuity reference is used when available
resolved storyboard verifies
rendered artifact is decodable
duration and streams are measured rather than assumed

episode_qa.executor: local vision plus deterministic media checks
success_evidence: technical QA evidence exists
visual continuity evidence exists
narrative beat coverage is checked
review decision is based on artifacts, not command exit codes

required_references: previous shot end frame when available
continuity.principle: reduce generation freedom between adjacent shots instead of relying on prompt text alone

quality_gates.repair_policy: repair the smallest failed stage, preserve accepted upstream artifacts, then re-enter the failed gate

external_delivery.input_contract: an APPROVED artifact identity plus explicit destination/channel authorization

wechat.rule: MP4/video artifacts use send-video; send-file is for non-video attachments only

success_evidence: exact approved artifact identity is recorded before send
transport reports success
destination-side evidence verifies the sent video/message
delivery receipt records destination, channel, artifact hash, and destination message identity
